messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 476 omitted, sha256 cd77c145c869ec02>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: NotMentioned
confidence: 80
reason: The document restricts use and disclosure of Confidential Information but never addresses whether the Receiving Party may make copies; it only discusses return of materials and copies in Section 7 ('together with all copies thereof') without granting permission to create copies.
(no quotes)
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: NotMentioned
confidence: 66
reason: The agreement addresses disclosure, use, and return of Confidential Information 'together with all copies thereof', but never expressly permits or prohibits the Receiving Party from making copies.
(no quotes)
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 72
reason: The return clause expressly contemplates that the Receiving Party or its Representatives may hold copies of Confidential Information, which implies that copying is permitted in some circumstances.
<quote check="exact">the Confidential Information listed, together with all copies thereof, in the possession of the Receiving Party or its Representatives</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Entailment", "confidence": 70, "quotes": ["the Confidential Information listed, together with all copies thereof, in the possession of the Receiving Party or its Representatives"], "reason": "The return clause contemplates copies of Confidential Information in the Receiving Party's possession, implying copying is permitted in some circumstances."}
